mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/edc61c9c3a1d-t1/ws/prep && cat > /srv/leakruns/edc61c9c3a1d-t1/ws/prep/prepare.py <<'EOF'
"""design_E6D6 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특징 행렬과 분할 생성 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
D = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_E6D6.json").read_text())

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# --- 예측 시점(tp) = 퇴원 시각, 입원 1건 = 표본 1건
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]

# --- 결과: 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a["next_admit"] > a["tp"]) & (a["next_admit"] <= a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
data_end = a["admit_time"].max()
a["followup_complete"] = (a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) <= data_end

# --- 코호트
a = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
n0 = len(a)
a = a[a["age"] >= 18]
n_adult = len(a)
a = a[a["discharge_status"] != "died"].copy()
n_final = len(a)

# --- 특징
X = a[["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "tp", "unit", "discharge_status", "sex", "age"]].copy()
X["los_h"] = (a["discharge_time"] - a["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 열이 없어 파생
X["n_prior_adm"] = a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount().values

win = a[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]]
def lab_agg(test, how):
    m = labs[labs["test"] == test].merge(win, on="admission_id")
    m = m[(m["report_time"] >= m["admit_time"]) & (m["report_time"] <= m["tp"])]
    if how == "last":
        return m.sort_values("report_time").groupby("admission_id")["value"].last()
    return m.groupby("admission_id")["value"].min()
X["cr_last"] = X["admission_id"].map(lab_agg("creatinine", "last"))
X["hgb_min"] = X["admission_id"].map(lab_agg("hemoglobin", "min"))

od = orders[orders["order_type"] == "dialysis_order"].merge(win, on="admission_id")
od = od[(od["order_time"] >= od["admit_time"]) & (od["order_time"] <= od["tp"])]
X["dialysis_ordered"] = X["admission_id"].isin(od["admission_id"]).astype(int)

# 진단: 시각 정보가 없어 '해당 입원(index admission)'에 연결된 코드로만 한정 (설계서 미명시 — 보고서 참조)
X["n_dx"] = X["admission_id"].map(dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
X["dx_ckd"] = X["admission_id"].isin(dx.loc[dx["icd_code"].str.startswith("N18"), "admission_id"]).astype(int)
X["dx_chf"] = X["admission_id"].isin(dx.loc[dx["icd_code"].str.startswith("I50"), "admission_id"]).astype(int)

X["readmit_30d"] = a["readmit_30d"].values
X["followup_complete"] = a["followup_complete"].values

# --- 분할: family_id 그룹 홀드아웃. family_id 결측(약 80%)은 patient_id로 대체해 같은 환자가 갈라지지 않게 함
X["split_group"] = X["family_id"].fillna(X["patient_id"])
sp = design["split"]
rng = np.random.default_rng(sp["seed"])
groups = X["split_group"].unique()
rng.shuffle(groups)
n_test = int(round(len(groups) * sp["test_fraction"]))
test_groups = set(groups[:n_test])
X["split"] = np.where(X["split_group"].isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

assert X.groupby("patient_id")["split"].nunique().max() == 1
assert X.groupby("split_group")["split"].nunique().max() == 1

X.to_csv(OUT / "model_frame.csv.gz", index=False)
summary = {
    "n_admissions_all": n0, "n_after_adult": n_adult, "n_after_excl_died": n_final,
    "n_patients": int(X["patient_id"].nunique()),
    "outcome_rate": float(X["readmit_30d"].mean()),
    "outcome_rate_by_discharge_status": X.groupby("discharge_status")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "n_incomplete_followup": int((~X["followup_complete"]).sum()),
    "missing_rate": X[["cr_last", "hgb_min"]].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "split_counts": X["split"].value_counts().to_dict(),
    "split_outcome_rate": X.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "family_id_missing_patients": float(p["family_id"].isna().mean()),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
